contentText: Eleven people, including two aides to a French far-left lawmaker, were arrested in France overnight and early on Wednesday on suspicion of involvement in the killing of ​far-right activist Quentin Deranque last weekend ‌in Lyon, according to the Lyon prosecutor's office, which has opened a murder investigation. France 24's James Andre takes a look at what we know about the investigation so far and the shockwaves it is sending through French politics.
